name: HELAO-async
description: HELAO-async is the Caltech HTE group’s instrument control software, implementing HELAO design principles as a distributed system of cooperating FastAPI and Bokeh servers (action drivers, orchestrators, visualizers, and operator UIs) launched as a configurable orchestration group. It bundles instrument drivers, API server configurations, experiment sequences, and pydantic data models, with the former helao-core framework merged in-tree. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
